service.name: t1
service.head: S
service.derivation: expert: a specialties tag or list-only mention is weak evidence x = specialty evidence weight when the only mention is a specialties item

service.name: t2
service.head: S
service.derivation: v1 weak stratum 1/12 confirmed: logit -2.04 = b + t1 + t2, so t2 = -2.04 - (-2.9) - 0.4

service.name: t3
service.head: S
service.derivation: v1 strong 10/12 vs weak 1/12: LLR 3.47 split over t3, t4, t5/2, p1, p2/2

service.name: t4
service.head: S
service.derivation: same split as t3 (2+ fields is the core of the strong stratum)

service.name: t5
service.head: S
service.derivation: same split as t3 (about half of strong pairs carry a unit or quantity)

service.name: trunc0
service.head: S
service.derivation: expert: no mention on a record whose list hit the 50-item cap says less; also when the only mention is a specialties item

service.name: d_unit
service.head: S
service.derivation: a dataset detail (equipment count, unit beds, 24x7 unit) is one own unit from the same text: the t2 step, only when T < 2 (D is not independent of T)

service.name: tb_mid
service.head: S
service.derivation: half of tb_high; bucket by URL count 8 to 29 (v1 n_urls cut, q_share not in v2)

service.name: tb_high
service.head: S
service.derivation: merge audit: contamination 59.6% of records at 30+ URLs vs 4.2% at < 3 URLs; LLR log(0.404/0.958); 30+ URLs

service.name: tp_public
service.head: S
service.derivation: log P(own | OR 2.34) / P(own) at the mid bucket (q 0.377 -> 0.586), applied when T >= 2
service.source: PATTERNS 1: public hospital contamination OR 2.34 (1.79 to 3.07)

service.name: tw_none
service.head: S
service.derivation: log P(own | OR 1.34) / P(own) at the mid bucket (q 0.377 -> 0.448), applied when T >= 2
service.source: PATTERNS 3: no website contamination OR 1.34 (1.12 to 1.59)

service.name: c2

service.name: n1

service.name: p2
